sponsorship.title: Fractionalized Player Sponsorship
sponsorship.description: Fans and investors will soon be able to buy "Player Tokens" to fund a player's training and travel — with revenue routed transparently back on-chain.
sponsorship.metaDescription: Support talented players from underserved regions through fractionalized XLM sponsorship on the Stellar blockchain. ScoutOff connects fans and backers directly with scouted talent.

Funds raised go directly toward training, travel, and development costs, while a share of the player's future on-chain revenue is routed back to token holders — all enforced by Soroban smart contracts.

privacy.page_description: How ScoutOff collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacy.section1_content: ScoutOff is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information. By using ScoutOff, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
privacy.section2_content: On-chain data: Your Stellar public key, transaction history, subscription status, and registration data are stored on the Stellar blockchain. This data is public, immutable, and cannot be deleted by anyone. Off-chain data: We collect contact details, profile metadata, chat messages, and usage analytics via Vercel Analytics and Sentry.
privacy.section3_content: Player profile media (photos, videos) is stored on IPFS, a decentralized storage network. Once uploaded to IPFS, media is publicly accessible and, due to the nature of the protocol, cannot be guaranteed to be completely removed from all network nodes.
privacy.section4_content: We use your data to provide and maintain the platform, process on-chain transactions, connect scouts with players, monitor platform performance, and comply with legal obligations.
privacy.section5_content: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with other users as directed by your actions, with service providers (Vercel, Sentry, Pinata), and as required by law.
privacy.section6_content: On-chain data is permanent and cannot be deleted. Off-chain data is retained for as long as necessary. You can request deletion of your off-chain data through account settings. Use the ‘Request Data Deletion’ action in Account Settings.
privacy.section7_content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or port your personal data. These rights apply only to off-chain data. For questions, contact us through ScoutOff’s official channels.

terms.page_description: Platform usage terms, fees, and the irreversible nature of on-chain actions.
terms.section1_content: By using ScoutOff, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the platform. ScoutOff is a decentralized football scouting platform built on the Stellar network.
terms.section2_content: You agree to use ScoutOff only for lawful purposes. You must not submit false information, use the platform to harass others, circumvent subscription fees, use automated tools without permission, or submit illegal content. We reserve the right to suspend access for violations.
terms.section3_content: All fees are denominated in XLM (Stellar Lumens). Fees include scout subscriptions and platform fees. Fees are non-refundable unless otherwise stated. All payments are processed on-chain via Soroban smart contracts.
terms.section4_content: Actions taken on the Stellar blockchain are permanent and irreversible. This includes player registrations, milestone approvals, subscription payments, and fee withdrawals. ScoutOff cannot reverse on-chain transactions once confirmed.
terms.section5_content: Players retain ownership of their profile content and personal data. By submitting content to ScoutOff, you grant us a license to display that content solely for the purpose of operating the platform. The platform’s code is open source.
terms.section6_content: ScoutOff is provided “as is” without warranties. We are not responsible for the accuracy of player information, IPFS content, losses from blockchain network issues, or smart contract bugs. Our liability will not exceed the fees you paid us in the 12 months prior to the claim.
